API reference

Public API scope

This template exposes no HTTP API or public JavaScript API. src/js/scripts.js is intentionally empty apart from comments. There are no service endpoints, authentication tokens, or request/response schemas to configure.

The reference below describes the npm build interface and file layout. Functions inside scripts/ are implementation details, not a stable library API.

npm commands

Run these commands from the repository root after npm ci .

npm run build
Cleans the output, then builds Pug, SCSS, scripts, and assets in sequence.
npm run clean
Deletes dist/ . Back up any direct output edits before running it.
npm run build:pug
Compiles Pug pages into HTML; layouts and include/mixin files are excluded as standalone pages. This does not clean stale output or build CSS/assets.
npm run build:scss
Compiles src/scss/styles.scss , including Bootstrap, into dist/css/styles.css .
npm run build:scripts
Copies src/js/ into dist/js/ and adds the template banner to scripts.js .
npm run build:assets
Copies src/assets/ into dist/assets/ .
npm start
Builds, watches source files, and runs a local BrowserSync preview.
npm run start:debug
Builds and launches the project's debug-mode preview workflow.
npm run test:docs
Checks existing generated documentation. Run a build first after changing source.
npm test
Builds the site and runs the documentation check.

Source and output contracts

  • src/pug/index.pug becomes dist/index.html .
  • src/pug/docs/*.pug becomes corresponding dist/docs/*.html files.
  • src/pug/layouts/docs.pug is shared by documentation pages and does not become a standalone page.
  • src/scss/styles.scss becomes dist/css/styles.css .
  • src/js/ and src/assets/ are copied into the matching output directories.

Preserve this output structure when publishing. The complete build is the supported way to remove stale generated files after deleting or renaming a page.
